description:
A customer named Emily Davis has contacted support about her most recent order. The 'USB-C Laptop Charger 65W' ($34.99) she received arrived with physical damage and is non-functional. She is satisfied with the other item in the order (Wireless Bluetooth Headphones).

Your task:
1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Orders in the WordPress admin panel.
2. Find and open the most recent completed order placed by Emily Davis (it contains 2 items totaling $114.98).
3. Process a partial refund for ONLY the 'USB-C Laptop Charger 65W' line item ($34.99).
4. Enter the refund reason as: 'Customer reported item arrived damaged'.
5. Confirm the manual refund (click 'Refund $34.99 manually').

Do NOT refund the Wireless Bluetooth Headphones. Only refund the USB-C Laptop Charger 65W.
